Pachouli Wellness Clinic is looking for a dynamic, target-oriented and experienced Center Manager / Clinic Head for its Noida 1704 center.

The candidate will be responsible for managing the overall clinic operations, conducting guest consultations and counselling, driving sales conversions, achieving revenue targets and ensuring excellent customer experience.

* Participate in client delivery reviews and contribute packaging status updates and quality metrics.

* Advanced MSI packaging — WiX Toolset, InstallShield, AdminStudio (expert-level repackaging and custom authoring)
* MSIX packaging — Package Support Framework, MSIX Packaging Tool, advanced compatibility fix development
* App-V sequencing — virtual application packaging, connection groups, dynamic configuration
* Intune Win32 and SCCM deployment — advanced deployment type configuration, Graph API integration
* PowerShell advanced scripting — detection scripts, pre/post-install automation, batch packaging operations
* Application compatibility — ACT, shims, PSF fixups, UAC/DPI/virtualisation remediation
* Windows internals — deep understanding of registry, file system, services, COM, WMI for packaging analysis
* Log analysis and troubleshooting — MSI verbose logs, AppEnforce.log, CMTrace, Event Viewer, Procmon

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  

* Experience with AdminStudio's Automated Application Converter for bulk MSI-to-MSIX migration
* Azure DevOps or CI/CD pipeline experience for packaging automation
* Flexera Software Vulnerability Manager or third-party patch management integration
* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator (MD-102) or equivalent

Advanced Application Packaging

* App-V sequencing — virtual application packaging, connection groups, dynamic configuration
